findings.title: Locale-stripping regex matches from the first underscore, not the locale separator
findings.body: The expression `replaceAll("_[a-zA-Z-_]*\\.properties", "_en.properties")` searches for the leftmost match in the whole file name, and the character class `[a-zA-Z-_]` allows letters and underscores anywhere, including the base name. For a file like `changedAnchor_de.properties`, the leftmost `_` is the one before `Anchor`, so the match is `_Anchor_de.properties` and the derived English file becomes `changed_en.properties` — which does not exist. The same applies to the `noHtml_de.properties` fixture, which resolves to `no_en.properties`. As a result the new tests `verifyNoChangedAnchors` and `verifyNoHtmlAllowed` will fail with `RuntimeException: unable to read file ...` instead of asserting the intended message. It works for production files only because they are all named `messages_<locale>.properties`. The regex should anchor to the locale suffix at the end, e.g. `_[a-z]{2}([_-][A-Za-z]{2})?\\.properties$`, or strip the suffix via `lastIndexOf('_')`.

findings.title: Lithuanian totpStep1 replaced with Italian text
findings.body: In the Lithuanian account messages file, `totpStep1` was changed to `Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:`, which is Italian, not Lithuanian. Lithuanian users will see an Italian sentence in the TOTP setup instructions. The same wrong text was also written to the Lithuanian login file (`loginTotpStep1` in `themes/src/main/resources-community/theme/base/login/messages/messages_lt.properties`, line 71), so it looks like a copy-paste from the Italian translation. Both entries should be replaced with a proper Lithuanian translation of the new English source 'Install one of the following applications on your mobile:'.

findings.title: zh_CN totpStep1 written in Traditional Chinese characters
findings.body: In the Simplified Chinese (zh_CN) account messages file, the new `totpStep1` value `在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一：` uses Traditional Chinese characters (手機, 裝, 應用程式) that are inconsistent with the rest of the file, which is written in Simplified Chinese (e.g. 打开应用扫描二维码输入验证码 directly below). Simplified Chinese readers will notice mixed scripts; the string should be rewritten in Simplified Chinese, e.g. 在您的手机上安装以下应用之一：.
